input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The liability regime meets our preferred position. Section 21.1 imposes a single mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000; "Fees" (§1.5) is a meaningful recurring subscription/professional services/usage base, not an illusory set-up fee, so the cap is real. Section 21.2 excludes indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive and consequential damages mutually ("neither Party"), and helpfully confirms data-restoration, replacement services, notice and incident-response costs are direct damages. Section 21.3 places outside the cap each Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection or security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's IP — the full preferred carve-out set — and confirms Customer's payment obligation is not damages subject to the limitation (narrowed to undisputed Fees for conforming Services, which favours us). No sub-cap, one-way limit or indemnity-inside-cap language appears elsewhere (warranty remedy in §19.4 is expressly non-exclusive for indemnified, confidentiality, privacy, security, fraud and infringement claims), and §21.4 is customary savings language only. No redline required.
